title: Water Purification
description: Covers five purification methods in depth: boiling with altitude adjustments, chlorine and iodine, UV devices and SODIS, commercial and DIY filters, and distillation. Includes a decision matrix for combining methods, storage guidelines, and action cards for when you have no equipment or suspect a chemical spill.
shortDescription: Boiling, chemical, UV, filtration, and distillation, and when to use each
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
